outcome: Antenatal suspicion of placenta accreta spectrum (PAS)
finding: Pregnant people with PAS who underwent IVF are less likely to have an antenatal suspicion compared with non-IVF patients.
mod_finding: Pregnant individuals who underwent IVF and developed placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) were less likely to have an antenatal suspicion of PAS compared to those who did not undergo IVF, potentially due to the lower incidence of prior cesarean deliveries in the IVF group.
